name: Grace and Frankie
description: Elegant, proper Grace and freewheeling, eccentric Frankie are a pair of frenemies whose lives are turned upside down - and permanently intertwined - when their husbands leave them for each other. Together, they must face starting over in their 70s in a 21st century world.

videos.title: The End
videos.overview: Grace and Frankie are stunned when their husbands inform them that they want divorces. They're even more stunned when they find out why.

videos.title: The Credit Cards
videos.overview: The messy realities of divorce start to sink in for Grace, Frankie, Robert, Sol and their equally frazzled adult children.

videos.title: The Dinner
videos.overview: Grace and Frankie decide to go back to work. Robert and Sol have an awkward dinner party for their children.

videos.title: The Funeral
videos.overview: Emotions run high when a funeral throws Grace, Frankie, Robert and Sol together in public for the first time since the split.

videos.title: The Fall
videos.overview: Grace has an eye-opening experience when she goes out for frozen yogurt with Frankie and Briana on a Saturday night.

videos.title: The Earthquake
videos.overview: Sol takes care of Frankie after she has an earthquake freak-out, while Grace goes on her first date. Coyote pays Mallory a surprise visit.

videos.title: The Spelling Bee
videos.overview: Frankie, Grace and Briana have unexpected encounters when they try new ways to deal with being single.

videos.title: The Sex
videos.overview: Frankie takes a new look at her Yam Man Jacob, while Grace and Guy get closer. Bud and Coyote have a brotherly talk. Sol is terrified of Briana.

videos.title: The Invitation
videos.overview: Briana tries Frankie's homemade organic beauty product. Robert finds out about Guy and Grace. Frankie tries to set boundaries with Sol.

videos.title: The Elevator
videos.overview: After they sign the divorce papers, Frankie, Grace, Sol, Robert and Bud remember a pivotal weekend from five years before.

videos.title: The Secrets
videos.overview: Grace tells Frankie a secret that Frankie shares with Sol, setting off multiple arguments in both houses. Briana gets closer with a co-worker.

videos.title: The Bachelor Party
videos.overview: Bud and Coyote ask Briana and Mallory to help them throw Sol and Robert's bachelor party. Grace offers to do ANYTHING to cheer up Frankie.

videos.title: The Vows
videos.overview: As the wedding day approaches, Grace and Robert have problems expressing themselves, while Sol and Frankie finally clear out their old house.

videos.title: The Wish
videos.overview: Sol plans to tell Robert about his betrayal. Frankie is determined to finally separate emotionally from Sol, but events pull her back in.

videos.title: The Vitamix
videos.overview: Brianna, Mallory and Bud help Sol deal with wedding details. A visit to Robert and Sol's house brings up strong emotions for Grace and Frankie.

videos.title: The Negotiation
videos.overview: Brianna wants to produce Frankie's organic yam lube. Grace competes for her grandchildren's affection. Frankie reconnects with her Yam Man, Jacob.

videos.title: The Road Trip
videos.overview: Frankie tracks down Grace's former love Phil on the internet, and the two set off to find him. Tensions arise between Sol and Robert.

videos.title: The Test
videos.overview: Frankie has difficulty passing the test to renew her driver's license. Grace attempts to amp up her social life by reconnecting with old friends.

videos.title: The Chicken
videos.overview: While Grace mentors a young woman seeking a new career, Frankie has conflicted feelings for Jacob, who wants more than a business relationship.

videos.title: The Boar
videos.overview: Grace intervenes after Robert and Sol's big fight. Frankie opens up to Jacob. An online friend request from Phil surprises Grace.

videos.title: The Anchor
videos.overview: Frankie has issues with Brianna's ideas for her yam lube and makes a stand. Phil asks Grace out for lunch. Sol tries to work things out with Robert.

videos.title: The Goodbyes
videos.overview: Coyote shares some surprising news. Things go awry when Frankie and Sol host a family brunch. Grace must make a difficult decision about Phil.

videos.title: The Loophole
videos.overview: Grace and Phil get closer, but complications arise. Sol and Robert square off on opposite sides of the conflict between Frankie and Brianna.

videos.title: The Bender
videos.overview: Grace and Frankie nurse their emotional wounds: Frankie performs a ritual on the beach, and Grace goes out drinking. Bud and Coyote meet Jacob.

videos.title: The Party
videos.overview: As Frankie helps her old friend Babe plan a big bash, she's faced with a troubling decision. Grace tries to make amends to Frankie.

videos.title: The Coup
videos.overview: Frankie and Grace receive surprise gifts from Babe that open new horizons for each of them. Sol reveals a long-held secret at Bud's birthday party.

videos.title: The Art Show
videos.overview: Grace and Frankie try to get a bank loan to help start their new business. Frankie's art show is rife with family tensions and minor dramas.

videos.title: The Incubator
videos.overview: Grace and Frankie pitch their business plan at a hip startup incubator. Grace fights with Jacob. Sol and Robert play hooky from work.

videos.title: The Focus Group
videos.overview: Grace and Frankie put together a focus group to test their vibrator prototype, but things go awry. Robert and Sol audition for a play.

videos.title: The Burglary
videos.overview: After they're robbed, Frankie is rattled, but Grace has a secret. With Robert in rehearsals and making new friends, Sol feels left out.

videos.title: The Gun
videos.overview: Furious about Grace's revelation, Frankie refuses to make up with her. In the wake of his fight with Sol, Robert decides to come out to his mother.

videos.title: The Pot
videos.overview: Frankie refuses to go home, and all the kids are dragged into Grace and Frankie's fight. Grace, Brianna and Mallory smoke Frankie's pot together.

videos.title: The Floor
videos.overview: The ladies hurt their backs and can’t get off the floor. Coyote looks for a new home. Robert frets over unresolved issues with his mom.

videos.title: The Alert
videos.overview: Grace and Frankie launch their business, and Bud brings gifts they're reluctant to accept. Sol is upset that Bud wants to fire a longtime employee.

videos.title: The Apology
videos.overview: Jacob shares something with Frankie that upsets her. Everyone rallies around Robert when his mother dies. Mallory confides in Brianna.

videos.title: The Labels
videos.overview: Sol and Robert pitch in when Grace and Frankie are overwhelmed with orders. Bud is thrown for a loop by his girlfriend’s interest in the Ménage à Moi.

videos.title: The Other Vibrator
videos.overview: Grace and Frankie send a cease and desist letter to the company that stole their idea. A homophobic church group protests Robert's play rehearsals.

videos.title: The Musical
videos.overview: Grace wants Frankie to go to the hospital after a medical incident, but Frankie insists on alternative healing. The protests disrupt Robert's play.

videos.title: The Sign
videos.overview: Grace and Frankie face a lawsuit. Sol fights back against the homophobic play protesters. Frankie mulls over a move that would change everything.

videos.title: The Lodger
videos.overview: Frankie feels left out of Grace's new friendship with Sheree, her new lodger. Sol and Robert are arrested. Bud and Allison throw a gender-reveal party.

videos.title: The Scavengender Hunt
videos.overview: Frankie shares what she discovered about Sheree to a skeptical Grace. Bud sends everyone on a scavenger hunt. Frankie makes a big decision.

videos.title: The Tappys
videos.overview: Grace and Frankie try to help Sheree get her house back... using both legal and illegal methods. Robert is nominated for a Tappy acting award.

videos.title: The Expiration Date
videos.overview: Grace fears her relationship has reached its expiration date. Frankie faces an existential crisis when she learns she's been declared legally dead.

videos.title: The Pop-Ups
videos.overview: Grace and Frankie hold vibrator pop-up sales at a senior center and a college. Sol and Robert have a disagreement. Bud and Allison hit a roadblock.

videos.title: The Hinge
videos.overview: Frankie reconnects with someone important from her past. Despite problems with her knee, Grace refuses to slow down. Robert tries to make amends.

videos.title: The Landline
videos.overview: Frankie and Sol have a blast devising a plan to get Frankie declared legally alive again. Grace faces some truths at a funeral she attends with robert.

videos.title: The Lockdown
videos.overview: Frankie convinces Allison to have a home birth. Grace and Frankie wind up stuck with a bickering Robert and Sol when there's a neighborhood lockdown.

videos.title: The Knee
videos.overview: Nick helps Grace while she's recovering from surgery. Jacob gets upset with Frankie because she wants to spend all their couple time with the baby.

videos.title: The Death Stick
videos.overview: Robert and Sol begin therapy. Grace and Frankie get a surprise when they bring gifts to a fan of their vibrators. Brianna's nemesis makes an offer.

videos.title: The Tub
videos.overview: Grace hires a contractor to fix an issue at the beach house. Sol's new friendship makes Robert uncomfortable. Frankie gets lost with the baby.

videos.title: The Rats
videos.overview: As Grace and Frankie deal with a major disaster in their home, they each keep secrets from other family members. Everyone attends Robert's play.

videos.title: The Home
videos.overview: Prompted by their children, Grace and Frankie make a change. Robert and Sol channel some fresh energy into their marriage.

videos.title: The House
videos.overview: Grace and Frankie visit the beach house while their worried kids try to track them down. Robert and Sol are caught in an embarrassing situation.

videos.title: The Squat
videos.overview: Refusing to leave the beach house, Grace and Frankie get support from their ex-husbands -- who are having their own issues with an unexpected visitor.

videos.title: The Aide
videos.overview: Bud convinces Frankie to hire a home health aide. Grace fumes when she learns about Brianna’s changes to Say Grace. Robert hopes to influence Peter.

videos.title: The Crosswalk
videos.overview: Grace and Brianna clash at work as Grace faces a tough day. With Joan-Margaret's help, Frankie fights ageism. Peter's casting decision shocks Robert.

videos.title: The Pharmacy
videos.overview: An unexpected encounter sparks regret in Grace. Sol acts cagey about his new dog's origins. A stranger's ambush of Coyote leads to a revelation.

videos.title: The Retreat
videos.overview: Frankie takes Grace on a girls trip, which isn't exactly the spa retreat Grace was expecting. Mallory goes on a date. An old friend rebuffs Frankie.

videos.title: The Tremor
videos.overview: While Frankie worries she's lost her authenticity, Grace frets about Frankie's health. Bud's first meeting with Allison's father goes downhill fast.

videos.title: The Ceremony
videos.overview: Robert feels out of place with the younger guys at rehearsals. Grace doesn't like the new man in Frankie's life. Brianna must make a difficult choice.

videos.title: The Website
videos.overview: When the Vybrant website goes down, Grace and Frankie must negotiate with a demanding man from Walden Villas. Sol becomes more assertive.

videos.title: The Highs
videos.overview: Grace takes extreme measures to keep up her hectic schedule. Sol and Frankie have a disagreement about Coyote. Frankie bonds with Robert over edibles.

videos.title: The Video
videos.overview: While Frankie tries to dig herself out of the business mess she created, Grace comes up with a different solution. Brianna goes to bat for Barry.

videos.title: The Wedding
videos.overview: Grace returns to town to find that Frankie has everything under control. Bud and Allison's wedding day arrives, but not without some family drama.

videos.title: The Alternative
videos.overview: In the wake of their big fight, Grace and Frankie imagine what their lives would be like if they hadn't lived together for the last three years.

videos.title: The Newlyweds
videos.overview: Frankie is stunned by Grace's news, but she buries her feelings -- until everyone gathers together to send off Bud and Allison.

videos.title: The Rescue
videos.overview: While Frankie tries to adjust to living alone, Grace arranges a family dinner that takes an awkward turn. Robert and Sol plan a honeymoon trip.

videos.title: The Trophy Wife
videos.overview: Grace's insecurities flare at a lavish fundraiser, where Frankie gets swept up in a silent auction. Sol hosts a game night to distract a worried Robert.

videos.title: The Funky Walnut
videos.overview: Robert and Sol grapple with a health scare, while Grace's bad knee sparks a new business idea. Coyote connects with Bud's ex-girlfriend.

videos.title: The Confessions
videos.overview: Grace worries that Nick isn't satisfied with their sex life. Sol decides to keep his diagnosis a secret, and Coyote comes clean about Jessica.

videos.title: The Bad Hearer
videos.overview: Robert's fussing irritates Sol. Barry presses Brianna and Mallory to make up. Frankie's date with Jack inspires a marketing strategy for the Rise Up.

videos.title: The Surprises
videos.overview: Grace wants to leverage Jack's celebrity connections... and Sol and Robert realize they've met him before. Bud tries to prove he's over Jessica.

videos.title: The Short Rib
videos.overview: Grace and Frankie introduce Jack to Nick, hoping they can all go on vacation together. Meanwhile, Barry finally gets his short-rib double date.

videos.title: The One-At-A-Timing
videos.overview: Frankie's enjoying having two men in her life, but Grace warns her it won't end well. Allison and Sol encourage Bud to get a DNA test.

videos.title: The Scent
videos.overview: Grace's plan for a relaxing spa day backfires. Frankie tries to find Joan-Margaret a husband. Robert hosts a fundraiser to save the community theater.

videos.title: The Laughing Stock
videos.overview: Grace and Frankie prepare for their pitch, but their prototype is missing. Robert keeps a secret from Sol. Brianna gets an appealing offer.

videos.title: The Tank
videos.overview: Grace's loyalties are tested as she and Frankie face the Sharks. Robert scrambles to recoup the money he donated. Bud meets his long-lost cousin.

videos.title: The Change
videos.overview: Grace tries to make amends to Frankie, Sol gives Robert a taste of his own medicine, and Brianna and Barry reach a turning point in their relationship.

videos.title: The Roomies
videos.overview: With their exes living at the beach house and FBI agents who arrested Nick sniffing around, Grace and Frankie frantically search for the money they hid.

videos.title: The Arraignment
videos.overview: While Frankie retrieves the cash, Grace and Nick discuss their marriage at his arraignment. Joan-Margaret hatches a plan for laundering the money.

videos.title: The Bunny
videos.overview: Bud tries to soothe discord at the beach house by throwing a brunch for the two families. But revelations from the past create even more hard feelings.

videos.title: The Circumcision
videos.overview: Nick has a chance to get out of jail, but Grace likes things the way they are. An old acquaintance helps Frankie with the money laundering.

videos.title: The Raccoon
videos.overview: Grace and Frankie adjust to their new housemate, Robert and Sol join the neighborhood watch, and Brianna reveals too much when she meets Barry’s parents.

videos.title: The Wire
videos.overview: The ladies try to help Nick reduce his sentence by implicating his partner. Sol attempts to catch a thief while Mallory establishes dominance at work.

videos.title: The Psychic
videos.overview: Grace and Frankie scramble to keep their friend Arlene from being moved into memory care. Nick gets in the way of Coyote's romantic plans.

videos.title: The Bonida Bandidas
videos.overview: Brianna and Mallory work with a conflict mediator who doesn't exactly have a great track record. Grace and Frankie try to smuggle drugs out of Mexico.

videos.title: The Prediction
videos.overview: Grace gets a distressing phone call that has Frankie questioning the future. Sol worries that Robert is experiencing memory loss.

videos.title: The Panic Attacks
videos.overview: After a trip to the ER, Frankie takes Grace to a therapist. Brianna brainstorms her next move and Coyote hits a snag in his marriage plans.

videos.title: The Horrible Family
videos.overview: Frankie decides to celebrate every annual holiday and special occasion in rapid succession. Grace finds a shocking connection to a rising politician.

videos.title: The Casino
videos.overview: The ladies don disguises and head to a casino to spy on Coyote. Brianna also pretends to be someone she's not to appease a potential investor.

videos.title: The Last Hurrah
videos.overview: Coyote confirms Allison's suspicion that Bud is lying to her. Grace goes after Nick for his tell-all book. Frankie seeks a happy ending of her own.

videos.title: The Paprikash
videos.overview: Grace craves a comforting dish from her childhood, but only her estranged brother has the recipe. Sol and Peter team up to blackmail a theater critic.

videos.title: The Fake Funeral
videos.overview: Frankie throws herself a funeral, leaving Grace to attend an important meeting alone. To Brianna's annoyance, her family rallies around Barry.

videos.title: The Beginning
videos.overview: Robert finally comes to terms with his memory loss. Grace and Frankie confront the possibility of immediate death — or aging for a few more years.

awards: Nominated for 13 Primetime Emmys. 3 wins & 62 nominations total
